import unittest

from solution import SparseTable


class SparseTableTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_empty_state_and_basic_presence(self):
        table = SparseTable()
        self.assertEqual(table.snapshot(), {})
        self.assertFalse(table.contains("missing"))
        with self.assertRaises(KeyError):
            table.fetch("missing")

    def test_none_is_a_stored_value(self):
        table = SparseTable()
        self.assertIsNone(table.put("nullable", None))
        self.assertTrue(table.contains("nullable"))
        self.assertIsNone(table.fetch("nullable"))
        self.assertEqual(table.snapshot(), {"nullable": None})

    def test_values_are_deep_copied_on_put_fetch_and_snapshot(self):
        table = SparseTable()
        supplied = {"items": [[1], {"x": 2}]}
        table.put("data", supplied)
        supplied["items"][0].append(9)
        supplied["items"][1]["x"] = 7
        self.assertEqual(table.fetch("data"), {"items": [[1], {"x": 2}]})

        fetched = table.fetch("data")
        fetched["items"][0].append(8)
        snap = table.snapshot()
        snap["data"]["items"][1]["x"] = 99
        snap["extra"] = True
        self.assertEqual(table.fetch("data"), {"items": [[1], {"x": 2}]})
        self.assertEqual(table.snapshot(), {"data": {"items": [[1], {"x": 2}]}})

    def test_update_preserves_insertion_position(self):
        table = SparseTable()
        table.put("first", 1)
        table.put("second", 2)
        table.put("first", 3)
        self.assertEqual(list(table.snapshot()), ["first", "second"])
        self.assertEqual(table.snapshot(), {"first": 3, "second": 2})

    def test_all_key_methods_validate_type_and_empty_value(self):
        table = SparseTable()
        operations = [
            lambda key: table.put(key, 1),
            table.fetch,
            table.contains,
        ]
        for operation in operations:
            for key in (None, 1, [], True):
                with self.subTest(operation=operation, key=key):
                    with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                        operation(key)
            with self.subTest(operation=operation, key=""):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    operation("")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
